description: This file contains utility functions for testing, specifically for reading a file into memory and printing input/output data for unit tests. It includes a function to read a file into a memory buffer and a function to print the contents of a file and a given string, useful for debugging test cases.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into memory, storing the size and buffer in a provided structure. Handles errors and memory allocation, and null-terminates the buffer.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file (if successfully read into memory) and a provided key-value pair string for debugging or test output.
